descriptions.w3d_d27a_plan_score_update_80017f0c: Starts from 1 or settings +124 if the worm is flagged, scales by a weapon count, adds a term from a second count, then divides or multiplies by 0x804aa74c depending on 0x80015434. Applies a distance falloff with 0x802e83cc and 0x802e8094 from the target 0x8041d3a0, a per-worm factor and settings +184. If settings +24 is 1, returns 0 when the worm is within the radius of any living component of the player list. Otherwise stores the score at +12 and returns 1.
